title: Text-to-SQL: An Analytics Copilot on Trap-Laden Data
summary: An analytics copilot answering business questions in SQL, measured on a goldset whose data hides the business rules a schema cannot show.
metrics: With the schema alone, Sonnet 5.5 answers 91 % of 81 runs correctly (Haiku 4.5: 58 %).
Sonnet 5.5: 9.51 USD per 1000 requests at 11.5 s p95 latency.
